title: The Spanish Empire
summary: From Columbus's first voyage in 1492, Spain built an overseas empire across the Americas and the Philippines. Its Council of the Indies, formed in 1524, governed the American colonies, with viceroyalties set up in New Spain in 1535 and Peru in 1543. Silver from mines such as Potosí flowed to Seville and brought economic change far beyond Spain. After the war of 1898, Spain gave up Cuba and ceded Puerto Rico, Guam and the Philippines to the United States.
